questions.question: Find the area of a kitchen floor 4 m long and 3 m wide, and explain the rule.
questions.expected_answer: The floor has 3 rows of 4 square metres, so the area is 4 × 3 = 12 square metres. The rule for a rectangle is length times width.

questions.question: Find the area of the L-shaped patio by splitting it into two rectangles.
questions.expected_answer: Split it into a rectangle 10 m by 3 m and a rectangle 4 m by 5 m. Their areas are 30 and 20 square metres, so the total area is 50 square metres.

questions.question: Explain why the area of a 4 m by 3 m rectangle is not 7 square metres.
questions.expected_answer: 7 is 4 plus 3, which only adds one length and one width. Area counts all the squares inside: 3 rows of 4 squares, which is 12 square metres.
